{{Quote|He made a mistake, Lolo!''"<br />"''Which everyone seemed to forget, including you! I didn't. Did you honestly think he had the moral right to lead us after he betrayed us?|Padmé Amidala and Lolo Purs, on Onaconda Farr|<ref name="Senate Murders">{{TCW|Senate Murders}}</ref>}}
'''Lolo Purs''' was the [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Aide/Legends|aide]] to [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]] and the [[Junior Representative/Legends|Representative]] of [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Gender/Legends|She]] eventually turned on Farr, believing he was weak, and [[Death/Legends|murdered]] him.

==Biography==
{{Quote|He was ''weak''. We needed someone with ''strength'' to stand against this war. I tried to scare him at the docks but he wouldn't go away, so I removed him. And when I heard Deechi knew about that meeting, he had to go too.|Lolo Purs admits to her murders of Farr and Deechi|<ref name="Senate Murders" />}}
[[File:Padme_knocks_lolo_out.png|thumb|left|200px|Padmé Amidala knocks Lolo Purs out.]]
Purs was a relatively young member of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] and a devout supporter of the Republic. This lead her to become the [[Aide/Legends|aide]] of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr.]] Like Farr, Purs wanted to see a peaceful resolution to the devastating Clone Wars.<ref name="TVB">{{WebCite|url=http://programme.tvb.com/kids/starwarstheclonewars2/more/cast|text=The Clone Wars characters|work=tvb.com|archivedate=20100129081531}}</ref>

<nowiki> </nowiki>However, she developed a grudge against her mentor for bringing the war to [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] in his [[Mission to Rodia/Legends|dealings]] with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Her actions culminated in her [[Death/Legends|murder]] of Farr when she attempted to pin the blame on Senator [[Halle Burtoni/Legends|Halle Burtoni]]. Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], a close friend of Farr's, decided to investigate Farr's murder after believing the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] was not doing a good enough job in finding the murderer. Amidala discovered that [[Mee Deechi/Legends|Mee Deechi]] had also been murdered, leading her to believe it was Halle Burtoni.<ref name="Senate Murders" />

Amidala attempted to arrest Burtoni, but she discovered that it was, in fact, Lolo Purs, Farr's aide. Purs took Amidala hostage at gunpoint, but she was knocked unconscious by a punch from Amidala and arrested by the Coruscant Security Force.<ref name="Senate Murders" />

==Behind the scenes==
Purs was voiced by [[Jennifer Hale]], who also portrayed [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] and Senator [[Riyo Chuchi/Legends|Riyo Chuchi]] in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'' television series]].
